tasks.title: Pharmacy WhatsApp bot not working at all; no messages logged since Oct 25
tasks.brief: Owner Ahmed: the pharmacy WhatsApp bot (Apps Script in elsousypharmacy-create/pharmacy) does not work at all, and the newest messages NOVA has are from Oct 25. Find the exact root cause: read the bot code, recent merges (pharmacy PRs #69/#70, the NOVA bridge), doPost error paths, missing Script Properties crashing the handler, token expiry, webhook target, Apps Script deployment version, quotas. Also check the sheet 11O_CkemBGq3WEsQ2eGVW9ASJ0iNn3UPfHpmj4YMOcCM log tabs (read-only). If it is a code bug, open a PR in the pharmacy repo for Ahmed's review only (do NOT merge). Make the bot never fail to reply because of the NOVA forward (forward must be try/catch, async, non-blocking). Do not touch WA_TOKEN or Script Properties, no WhatsApp sends to customers. Write the diagnosis to .nova/reports/wa-bot-down.md with exact steps Ahmed must do if any (e.g. renew Meta token, redeploy Apps Script new version).
tasks.acceptance: Root cause with evidence in .nova/reports/wa-bot-down.md; PR for review if code bug; no merge in pharmacy repo.
